pages.text: You are given one Wayfarer's Almanac the first time you join a world. It is never handed out again, so dying or reloading cannot fill your chests with copies.$(br2)You do not need the item to read it: press $(k:key.emberveil.open_almanac) or type $(item)/almanac$() (no cheats needed).
Want a copy to carry or give to a friend? Combine any Book with a Torch.
